The all-ones n×n matrix J satisfies J^k = n^(k-1) * J. So J^5 = 33^4 * J mod 5. 33 mod 5 = 3. 3^4 = 81 mod 5 = 1. So J^5 mod 5 = J (all entries = 1 mod 5).
